rv.q: The cast and creative team have crafted a pinnacle production that will change the way you see theatre.
Signature has taken what was already a well-written show and given it the glimmer and gloss to be a masterpiece.
A scintillating take on an enduringly modern musical, Signature Theatre’s Pippin succeeds as the sum of bold and exciting choices in every detail.
You won’t want to miss your corner of this brilliant sky.
The result is funny, visually inventive, musically vibrant, and emotionally satisfying—a revival that captures both the show's exuberant surface and the melancholy that lurks just beneath it.
Gardiner’s “Pippin” features an ensemble cast, flawless choreography by Rachel Leigh Dolan and vocal performances that’ll knock your socks off.
The Tony Award-winning musical takes on a magical intimacy.
Signature's Pippin is an intriguing spectacle, being given a memorable production, which continues through July 26.

cn.t: Critics hail Signature Theatre's "Pippin" as a dazzling triumph, praising Matthew Gardiner's bold vision, stunning choreography, and eye-popping visuals that bring fresh energy to Schwartz's enduring 1972 musical about the search for meaning.
